title: Gluing $\partial$-Morin maps on manifolds with boundary and its applications
summary: We study $\partial$-Morin maps, a class of smooth maps from manifolds with boundary such that both the maps themselves and their restrictions to the boundary have only Morin singular points, and the singular point sets of the maps are disjoint from the boundary. We develop a gluing construction that provides a unified framework for studying maps from manifolds with boundary through corresponding maps from closed manifolds.
